en: I'll keep an eye out for it.
note: keep an eye out for + 东西：一边走一边留意找

en: It's no more than a three-minute walk.
note: no more than：最多、不超过；a three-minute walk：步行三分钟的路程

zh: 走过去应该五分钟左右。
en: You should be able to walk there in five minutes, give or take.
note: give or take：放在数字后面，表示「左右」

zh: 我都清楚了，不用再说了。
note: I'm all set：我都好了，不需要别的了；也可以回答店员「还要什么吗」

en: Thanks, but I've really got to get going.
note: I've got to = I have to；get going：动身、出发

zh: 抱歉，我这周六要出去旅行，所以没时间去爬山。
en: Sorry, I'm going on a trip this Saturday, so I don't have time to go hiking.
note: go on a trip：去旅行；don't have time to + 动词原形；爬山说 go hiking

zh: 我约了医生。其实我有点头疼。
en: I have a doctor's appointment. Actually, I have a bit of a headache.
note: a doctor's appointment：约了看医生（别漏 a）；头疼说 have a headache，不说 my brain is pain

zh: 要不我们下周六去爬山？我很想跟你一起去。
en: Maybe we can go hiking next Saturday? I'd love to go with you.
note: can 后面用原形：can go；I'd love to…：我很想……，婉拒后提出别的时间
